top_signals.title: Goldman Chief US Economist: Economy Isn't Overheating
top_signals.summary: Goldman Sachs’ David Mericle joins Bloomberg Open Interest to break down why the Fed could hike rates without committing to another move. He argues the US economy isn’t overheating, inflation pressures remain manageable, and the labor market is in a healthy balance, while warning that rising oil prices could complicate the Fed’s path. (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Russia Extends Diesel Export Ban Through October
top_signals.summary: Russia will extend its ban on diesel exports for all fuel producers to October 31, Vedomosti reported Tuesday, citing delayed refinery maintenance and the need to rebuild fuel reserves before winter. The ban, expanded in July from traders and small refineries to cover all producers, had been due to expire September 30. Diesel on the St. Petersburg commodity exchange traded at 70,546 rubles a ton in early September, and retail prices reached 88.44 rubles a liter on September 7, up 18.4% since the start of the year.
